description: This file defines a Config class in the OrangeHRM system that manages configuration parameters, constants, and related methods for accessing configuration data. It primarily contains static methods and constants to interact with the application's configuration settings.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A utility class for managing configuration settings, constants, and dependencies in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes configuration by loading settings if not already initialized.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration parameter by name, returning default if not found.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a configuration parameter exists.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds multiple configuration parameters at once.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks whether the system is installed by attempting to load configuration.

methods.name: getConf
methods.description: Returns the configuration object, optionally forcing a reload.
